title: Synthetic example: hotel with a regional possible ring

evidence.text: 6 reviewers share only travel businesses in one region, but their histories are mostly these places and their ratings are almost all 5★. This could be a group trip or a regional ring (possible ring, trip-like pattern).

caveats: This is a pattern, not proof.
Only the newest 88 reviews and the 25 highest-priority reviewers were examined.
Dates in reviewer histories are approximate.
Rings within a single city aren't detected.
Google may already have removed some reviews.
A business can be targeted without its knowledge: review-task scams hand recruits real businesses to review.
